source_snapshot.procedure: Installs stress-ng, clears dmesg, then runs `stress-ng -m 15 --vm 9 --vm-bytes 90% -t 8h`.
source_snapshot.criteria: System remains workable without unexpected errors.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires resolution of alias worker conflict, immutable logs, full8h profile and health gates.

old_problem: The command specifies two different values for the same VM-worker option and destructively clears the only stated kernel-log baseline.
disposition_reason: Official stress-ng documentation defines `-m N` as the short form of `--vm N`; therefore15 and9 are contradictory worker counts, not separate stressors. Because worker count affects how the90% allocation is divided and the OOM/swap risk, neither value can be selected without source-owner authority. ED-14 also forbids DeepSeek's300-second substitute and ED-17 forbids destructive evidence clearing.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row39 all18 XLSX cells and history2653.
Verified from the official stress-ng man page that `-m` and `--vm` identify the same VM worker option and percent memory is shared across VM stressors.
Preserved90%,8h and system-health coverage; no stress or dmesg clearing occurred.

test_case.test_name: Stress-ng90%-memory eight-hour validation pending VM-worker authority
test_case.purpose: Run one approved VM-worker count at an aggregate90%-available-memory target for eight hours and verify responsiveness plus memory/platform health.
required_package: Source-owner choice of15 or9 VM workers and signed exact command
Approved host memory/swap/NUMA/cgroup/cooling/power profile and aggregate90% interpretation
Immutable baseline/final logs, managed stop, cleanup and recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not run the contradictory command or `dmesg -c`. After worker authority, capture immutable kernel/BMC/ECC and memory/swap baseline; execute one approved `stress-ng --vm <N> --vm-bytes 90% -t 8h` profile with full metrics/verify/logging as supported by the pinned version; monitor continuously and stop on any approved gate.
test_case.expected_result: The entire approved eight-hour workload completes with the selected worker count and aggregate90% semantics, no disallowed OOM/ECC/watchdog/system error, and health remains within limits.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires one authoritative worker count, exact8h/90% execution and complete health evidence. Last-option behavior, a300-second smoke run or cleared logs cannot resolve the intended coverage.
safety_gate: Block until15-versus9 is decided and the exact command is signed.
Preserve kernel evidence; never clear dmesg/SEL to create a baseline.
Validate available memory, swap/cgroup and OOM behavior before launch.
Abort on OOM/swap storm, ECC, watchdog, telemetry, thermal or power limits; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Immutable baseline/final kernel/BMC logs and recovery disposition
test_case.recovery: If memory pressure causes OOM, swap storm or loss of responsiveness, invoke the prevalidated stop for the selected stress-ng process group, preserve OOM/task/memory/swap/ECC evidence, do not reboot or retry automatically, and require the memory owner to verify service and DIMM health before reuse.

source_conflict.reason: Official documentation confirms `-m` and `--vm` are aliases, leaving15-versus9 as an unresolved source choice.

blocked.reason: The source owner can choose the worker count and supply safety bindings.
